core_obligations: Spec(R) = V(f) amalga D(f) with V(f) = Spec(R/fR) and D(f) = Spec(R_f) by the spectrum section of the algebra chapter (proof lines 25179-25184). The map Spec(R_f) covers D(f) identically, and the map R -> R/fR factors through R' since R' -> R'/fR' is an isomorphism, so Spec(R') covers V(f); together the map Spec(R') amalga Spec(R_f) -> Spec(R) is surjective (proof lines 25184-25186). For the completion R -> R^wedge the induced map on R/fR is an isomorphism by the same-quotients lemma, so the last statement is a special case of the first (proof lines 25186-25186).
proof_roadmap: Decompose Spec(R) into V(f) and D(f) (proof lines 25179-25184).
Cover V(f) via the factorization through R' and identify the completion case via same-quotients (proof lines 25184-25186).
